text: How many holes of golf are there at RACV Torquay?

numeric.alternatives: RACV Torquay Resort's own golf page describes an 18-hole, par-71 links-style course overlooking Jan Juc and Torquay beaches, redesigned by Ogilvy Clayton (Geoff Ogilvy and Mike Clayton); it is also the home course of Torquay Golf Club. No mini-golf course at RACV Torquay could be confirmed from the resort site or search results; the Torquay mini-golf that guides mention belongs to The Sands Torquay, a separate resort. Some third-party hotel listings wrongly credit Stuart Appleby with the RACV course design (that is The Sands).

hostNotes: RACV Torquay has an 18-hole, par-71 links course overlooking Jan Juc and Torquay beaches, redesigned by former US Open champion Geoff Ogilvy and Mike Clayton. If anyone said 36 hoping for a mini-golf bonus, bad luck, the putt-putt in Torquay is at The Sands, not RACV.
